comment: Metadata is generated from the built assembly and its XML documentation, not from the
project. Two reasons, both of which broke project-based generation:
1. docfx bundles an older Roslyn than RefitClassSourceGenerator targets, so it refuses
to load the generator. The generated partial implementations then do not exist and
the section classes fail their Refit interfaces with CS0535, producing no API at all.
2. Meraki.Api multi-targets netstandard2.0 and net10.0. Project-based generation resolves
the default target framework, which would silently omit everything compiled only for
net10.0 - notably the whole Meraki.Api.Mcp namespace.
Build Meraki.Api in Release before generating. See 'Generating Documentation.md'.
